quote.text: Men set very great store by pensions and doles, and for these they hire out their labor or service or effort.   But no one sets a value on time; all use it lavishly as if it cost nothing.  But see how these same people clasp the knees of physicians if they fall ill and the danger of death draws nearer, see how ready they are, if threatened with capital punishment, to spend all their possessions in order to live!  So great is the inconsistency of their feelings.
quote.author: Seneca
quote.aiInsight:
• Parenthood
    • Just as time is an unpriced treasure, cherish every moment with your children, knowing that these moments are irreplaceable gifts that shape their growth.
    • Instill in your offspring the virtue of mindful living—teaching them to value effort and time over transient rewards ensures they develop a disciplined character.
  • Leadership
    • Embrace the understanding that every decision and action you take as a leader uses the same precious time that cannot be bought back—lead by showing consistency in valuing each moment.
    • Recognize that the pursuit of immediate gains may overshadow long-term well-being; lead others towards a balanced approach where strategic sacrifice today secures a prosperous tomorrow.
  • Product Management
    • Value each development cycle as if it were a fortune; careful planning and mindful iteration ensure that precious time is not squandered on fleeting trends.
    • Apply a long-term vision by resisting the lure of quick fixes—invest time wisely in sustainable growth and innovation, balancing immediate returns with future success.
